messages.text: Running ten minutes behind leaving the Wauwatosa clinic. My 8:00 brought the whole AAC binder plus crackers everywhere.
I can do Lucia pickup if your last little one runs long.
Gracias. Also Rafael asked if this Friday is their Lucia evening or the off week. I said off week but now I'm second guessing.
Off week. Next one is March 13, Pewaukee handoff after Suzuki.
Client has a weird drainage easement on a Brookfield lot. Is a 15-min sanity check too much to ask before poker?
Send the plat. I have the Wauwatosa curb plan open anyway, then I need to mark Ben's pond calcs before tomorrow.
Appreciated. PDF okay or do you need the CAD file?
PDF is enough for tonight. If it turns into contours or pipes, I'll pull it into Civil 3D at lunch.
Trevor left at 6:10 with three mugs of coffee and 94 sophomore essays. Send help.
Only if you send the reel of the boys arguing over the same green cup again.
They're 4 and already litigating like tiny judges. Also I saw your 11 pm email timestamp. Knock it off.
Fine, fine. Closing the laptop before your next threat.
Did Patel's office finally send you the portal note or are they still acting like fax machines are cutting-edge medicine?
It came through. Same October line she flagged, so I'm keeping the oatmeal routine and salmon twice this week.
Good. Also your old intake file probably still says 180, don't let them weigh you after lunch and shoes 😂
Appointment is at Aurora Wauwatosa, 8:20, so coffee only before. Five years there and I still forget the parking entrance.
Can you pull the Village portal receipt from 1/31? The $3,200 one. I found July's in the blue house folder.
Can you do the Menomonee stop after Lucia drop-off? She wants to see if the sand is still frozen by the quarry.
Yep. I'll download it before Lucia pickup and put both PDFs in the Brookfield packet.
Yes. I'll take the paved side first and skip the roots if my back starts barking.
Gracias. Sandra's checklist also asks for both our W-2s and the daycare letter, so don't just send your stuff.
Good. Also please don't test the old red frames in the garage yet, mi amor. February was enough.
Deal. Just a slow loop today. I'll check the beach gate and text you a pic for Lucia.
I know, team filing. I'll add your clinic W-2 when I scan mine.
Andres says their guest room is open Dec 24-28 if we do Colorado Christmas again.
Let's price it, but I don't want to turn his place into our annual hotel.
He laughed and said you earned a mattress after surviving Mateo's backyard birthday last July.
Tell Mateo I still blame that tiny brownie square for making me talk about storm drains for 40 minutes.
Sprecher's after Uihlein? I'm starving and they still have that pilsner on tap.
Yeah, one with the fish sandwich and I'm out. Early BD call tomorrow.
One? Very grown-up of you, engineer. I'll save us a table.
Make fun all you want. That pilsner actually works with the lemony stuff they put on the fish.
If Rafael is joining Saturday, tell him I am not listening to another 12-minute Khris Middleton monologue 😂
He earned it after sitting through my Brewers bullpen rant last week.
Fair. Sprecher after soccer then? I need your bracket of acceptable Fiserv snacks before I spend $18 wrong.
Pretzel, no cheese. Rafael will pretend to judge and then eat half.
Jamal texted me for your email again. He says the MICAH turnout sheet and the Habitat vote packet are both waiting on you.
Send him my work one. I can look after Lucia's bedtime, but I am not taking another recurring Tuesday.
Good, because Camila will personally erase you from Google Calendar if you add a fourth color block again 😂
She already circled the three I am allowed to keep. Library planning stays, Habitat stays, pantry is the swing one.
Mijo, cuando pases por Walgreens compra también la cajita azul para Lucia si está en oferta.
Voy antes de la oficina. Lo mío ya salió listo, $11 copay, 90 días.
Y no salgas sin pañuelo. Aquí todo el carro amaneció amarillo.
Sí, Ma. Camila también dejó el frasquito de eucalipto en la entrada por si termino con la nariz hecha trapo.
Mijo, si vas al supermercado compra yuca y choclo. La libra de corvina estaba buena en West Allis.
Tengo limones, cilantro y cebolla roja ya. After the 3:30 call I put everything on the board and started cutting.
Corta la cebolla fina y no te olvides el ají. Tu papá siempre ponía mucho.
I know. I might do the fish tonight and save the plantains for Saturday lunch.
You good for 8 at Uihlein tonight? Captain has you up top again if your leg is behaving.
I can do the first half up there. Cold snap has the old hinge cranky, so I may slide back after.
Works. Bring flats, they moved us to Field 2. Sprecher's after if you're not rushing home.
Flats are in the car. I already got my 5:45 spin done, so tonight is whatever the leg gives me.
Commute queue saved me after night shift: that Decoder interview + your ridiculous sand planet soundtrack rec.
Told you the drums make Capitol Drive feel more important than it is.
Also I started the first Three-Body book. Why did you not warn me I would need coffee AND a notebook.
Because then you would have ignored me. Wait until the game chapters get weird.
Mijo, the little folding stool is still in my closet. Do you need it for Saturday by the lake?
Yes please. I'm trying to keep the Arches block flat this time; the wind wrinkled everything last weekend.
I also found your father's old black pouch with the small lenses. Bring me one of your prints from those trees when you come Sunday.
Deal. I may stop at the Third Ward after, depending on how the light hits the brick alleys.
Captain wants to know if you're a real option next Wednesday or still doing spectator duty.
Real option, just not hero ball. Dr. Han cleared short shifts if I keep doing the Athletico homework.
Good. You've missed enough. I can put you wide and tell Diego to stop launching hospital passes.
Perfect. Also no driveway workouts for me next winter. That February cleanup humbled me.
Are you still at the office or did the Priya/David gauntlet release you?
Released. Priya made me say the number out loud until I stopped apologizing first.
Good. And David?
He crossed out half my preamble and wrote, 'lead with the work, then stop talking.'
Can I borrow your brain on that stormwater handout before Monday? You still in the Brookfield office late?
Yeah, here until 6:30. I can mark up the table but I only have maybe twenty minutes between the owner call and staffing check-in.
Twenty is enough. Wild that your old plan-review wizard time is now squeezed between calls 😂
Tell me about it. Since the January shuffle, the redlines are the treat after the meeting stack.
Mijo, Rosa mando fotos de los primos. Hector dice que Lucia ya esta grande para acordarse bien si van pronto.
Mijo, encontre el mitten de Lucia en mi bolsa. Creo que se metio cuando fui por ella al violin.
Mandamelas. Camila found the envelope with the 2017 boarding passes, so Lucia wants the whole story now.
That little pink one? Keep it at your condo for now. She'll need it when you come again in July.
Ella no estaba todavia en esas fotos. Este domingo pongo el iPad temprano para que saluden todos.
Bueno. Y Camila ya arreglo las fotos del lago? La nieve se veia bonita.
Perfect. I will have her practice her questions for Hector and Rosa before lunch.
She has them on her phone. Also HR finally fixed the second Feb week, so your mileage envelope wasn't sitting in my pile for nothing.
Mijo, if you pass Appleton Ave tomorrow, bring me dos conchas. The little place in the strip mall had the soft ones last time.
I can stop after Lucia's class. Camila also wants me to ask whether they have bolillos early.
And when those Saturday tables start again, get the round bread Lucia likes. Not the one from Pick n Save.
The crusty one from the guy by the Village lot. I'll remember.
At Sendik's. Fish, oats, produce, Lucia yogurt, sourdough. Keeping it under 225 or do we need detergent too?
Add detergent. If this run is 250-ish we're still on track for the 900 grocery line.
I moved my Dr. R slot to 11:30 Tuesday, so your Thursday 3:00 stays protected.
Okay. Also MKE Rec camp opens Monday. The two-week block is still 400 each week, right?
Gracias. I need that buffer this week. The archive box from the November city file is still sitting by my desk.
Yep. I moved 800 into the Lucia bucket so it doesn't hit like February did.
Then it stays closed until after the call. Same rule I use before Dr. R: no poking the bruise first. ❤️
Fair. I’ll take Lucia to violin after and not try to solve 2025 in one afternoon.
Marcus says he can bring the smoker next card night if we stop roasting his brisket like civilized adults.
He still owes the table from February. Also tell him I am not taking the bait on the court-race link he dropped.
😂 Fine. Wednesday after Uihlein, I want Sprecher's and zero speeches until the second pitcher.
Deal. I will sit between you two if the group chat gets spicy again.
Mijo, Father Esteban said he can stay after 10:30 Mass tomorrow if you want to light the candle for your papa.
Gracias Ma. I might. That corner of the church still helps me settle before the week.
I will bring the little photo. You bring yourself, no running out to check work email.
Deal. I also kept my two notebook nights already, so tomorrow can be the third.
Mijo, si voy manana, do I turn after the bypass or before? Last time I passed all those same brick houses twice.
After. Stay on Pilgrim, then the second left after the light. If you hit the school entrance you went too far.
Ok. I can take Lucia to the park after lunch? The one with the big hill.
Yes, Village Park is easy from here. Just five minutes if she brings the scooter.
Mijo, the kitchen looks brighter in Camila's photo. The little blue pieces by the stove came out pretty.
Thanks Ma. We finally let ourselves use the envelope we'd been feeding since September.
Bien. Now do not start knocking another wall because your mother likes one photo.
Not knocking anything. Just saving the measurements for the someday file.
You ever actually use that $1,500 work learning money, or does it just sit there until December like mine?
Using it this year. Stormwater modeling course is $1,275, so I can squeeze the book in too if finance approves it clean.
Nice. Mine keeps trying to route through reimbursement hell.
Same portal where I saw the $480/month family line and the March employer seed, so I screenshotted everything before it disappears.
You still have that 2.8 from the 2021 paperwork? My lender keeps pretending 6.4 is a favor.
If you do northern Arizona, do not be brave in July. Those red rock switchbacks cook people.
Yeah, not touching it. The 2018 paperwork still makes me laugh: 312k felt enormous then.
Camila already wrote NOV or MAR in all caps. Same doc has ferry towns and one Wisconsin Saturday tab, so she is keeping me honest.
Wild. I was looking at comps near you and the online estimate was what, mid-440s?
That sounds like three different maps and one very patient spouse.
Around 440 last I checked. Makes me more stubborn about sending extra to the CR-V before summer.
She called it 'staged, not chaotic.' I am choosing to believe her.
Heads up, Gloria said the condo office in West Allis finally fixed the hallway light. She told me twice like it was breaking news.
Good, I was going to ask her tomorrow. Last week she made it sound like she was sewing hems in a cave.
LOL. Also remind her not to take three neighbor pants jobs at once. She says retired means available to everyone.
I'll work it into the call gently. If I lead with that she'll pretend the connection froze.
Mrs. Ito just dropped the July table sign in our mailbox. Can you put it somewhere Pancho won't chew?
Top shelf by the vase. Lucia is already lobbying for the bubble machine again.
Of course she is. Also Ben texted that the yellow lab mix is back home, so call off your flashlight walk.
Good. I'll just take Pancho around the short loop after Sparkle gets fed.
You alive or buried under those dirt math problems again?
Buried. I gave myself 1:30-4:30 today and the retaining wall examples are winning.
Then stop adding extra committees, genius. Also ask the stamp lady before you turn in anything weird.
Already sent Erin the sketch package. And yes, I blocked two weeknights plus Sunday, no extras.
I opened the March sheet between clients. Your two-Friday month is throwing off the top summary again.
Use the annualized tab. Mine should average to 9,580 before deductions and about 6,200 after, even when only two deposits hit.
Got it. I added my clinic number under it and the combined row says 15,380. Does that match your copy?
Yes. Leave the 401k at 10 and HSA monthly alone for now, please.
Clinic ran 12 min over. I can still grab Lucia from Spanish, but can you thaw the salmon for tomorrow?
Yep. I'll pull it now and check the lemon situation.
Gracias. Tonight I'm doing lentils after I switch the towels to the dryer.
I'll clear the table and get the school forms out of your pile.
My students noticed those orange paint marks by S. 55th. Is that your crew or another city alphabet soup thing? ⚽
Ours, kind of. Survey before we lock the curb cuts, planting cells, and light-pole spacing.
If you want real comments, do the handouts in Spanish too. Half the aunties will not read the English packet.
Already pushed that. Also moving the Q&A to the church basement over there instead of asking everyone to drive downtown.
MPS sent another parent email with three different links. You know which one isn't junk?
I usually start with the CDC page, then I make Patel translate the gray areas into normal-human language.
Send me the page. My sister is asking about her 11-year-old and I do not want to become Facebook tío.
Sent. Also check the dates on your own card before Eagle River forms; mine had the fall entries but the scan was blurry.
Your UWM kids staying for beers after that panel or are you doing the responsible grownup thing? ⚽
No beers with them. I promised Daniela I'd look at her Culver stormwater writeup tonight and Mateo sent a LinkedIn note asking about first job negotiations.
Of course they found the guy who answers long messages after 9 pm.
Someday that habit becomes the whole shop: rain gardens, bus stops that don't flood, and junior staff who don't have to learn by being ignored.
Mijo, guardo frascos de vidrio para ti? Tengo tres de salsa y uno grande de aceitunas.
Si, please save them. The person at the library said wide-mouth ones are easiest for the pantry refill table.
Te los doy el domingo. Tambien tengo retazos de tela si todavia necesitas para esas tapas con elastico.
Perfect. I signed up for the March 19 sewing swap one, so scraps help.
You around for the board packet thing tonight or buried?
Buried, but from the basement desk today. I can read it after the 5:30 specs call.
Basement desk Tuesday, of course 😂. Don't make it another midnight PE binder night.
Trying. If I close the laptop by 6:45 I can get one set done and still be upstairs before 11.
Your kid just explained to my boys that the blue dog gets ONE after-dinner episode on school nights. Bossy tia energy.
She negotiated for Wild Kratts because her sharing bag has the consulate picture with the monarch craft.
LOL. She still has that paper flower crown from the lobby? My twins destroyed theirs in 9 minutes.
Hers is in the cubby with the birthday napkins. Six candles are apparently very serious business.
Bro why are you awake enough to react to my meme before school dropoff 😂
Done with 40 downstairs. Shower, Lucia breakfast, then spreadsheets.
Save some legs for tonight. We need someone making runs behind Priya, not another traffic cone.
Tell Priya I will make three smart runs and one deeply foolish one at 8.
Amor, before I leave: did you update the spreadsheet after the Honda drafts hit?
Yep. CR-V is just under 14k, Civic a little under 7k. I left the house line at 228 until the new statement posts.
Good. And please do not let the card sit just because this week is chaos.
Already scheduled the full pull for the 16th. Nothing weird there.
Before the 5:30 BD call: food, water, and do the 4-count thing in the car. Do not white-knuckle it, amor.
I ate half the turkey wrap. Hands are still doing the tiny shake thing.
Then notebook after Lucia's bath. Two lines counts. You don't need a performance.
I know. Father Esteban's old card is still in there, weirdly useful.
Board thing still at Village Hall tonight? I can swing past you if parking is awful over there.
I am walking over from home after dinner. Camila has Lucia's violin run, so I will meet you by the library doors.
From your place? Man, Falls geography is fake. You are tucked behind those 90s-looking streets but somehow everything is right there.
Pretty much. School one direction, park/library the other, then 41/45 when I need to get out.
You alive after last night or did Uihlein claim you again? ⚽
Alive. Twenty minutes total and I behaved. Ice pack after, then the stretchy band stuff.
Look at you making adult choices. Did you ever finish those tiny Walgreens tablets?
Nope. Took 4, maybe 5, that first week and left the rest alone. Camila hid them behind the vitamins anyway.
Village board packet is 142 pages. Tell me I can skip the engineering appendix before I lose my mind.
Read the two pages with the crosswalk islands and bus stop pad. The rest is AutoCAD sheet noise unless you love inlet tables.
You say that like inlet tables aren't Milwaukee-area bedtime literature.
Ha. I am already bouncing between that, West Allis alley drainage, Priya's ramp detail, and Ben's outfall comments, so bedtime is ambitious.
Bro, you left that topo link in the soccer thread. The elevation gain looks disrespectful 😂
Wrong thread, my bad. That one is for the high-country folder Camila and I keep pretending is 'research.'
Same folder as the cherry-label place up north and the desert photos?
Different tabs, same too-many-pins problem.
Client has a drainage easement mess in Brookfield. Could I send you a sketch after lunch?
Send it. I can sanity-check the grading logic, but I am buried in fee notes and two staffing calls until 4.
Got it. Also congrats again on the new nameplate. Saw it when I dropped the policy packet in January.
Thanks. Funny part is I still sneak in CAD time like dessert after eating my vegetables.
Can you confirm you're in for the 21st? $20 buy-in, Diego grilling, my bourbon unless someone complains again.
In. And I will bring the Sprecher's gift card I forgot after last Wednesday.
Good. Also, I read the article you sent. I still do not buy your argument, but it was better than the cable version.
That is all I ask. We can argue for ten minutes, then go back to blaming Diego for bad chips.
You in for Eagle River next Feb or are you blocked again?
Likely blocked same stretch. Camila already put a hold on the calendar and my mom asked which week Lucia has early release.
You still doing that spreadsheet template I sent, or did Camila ban me from making you optimize tabs?
Still using it. Regular month lands around 7,400 when I plug in house 2,150, Lucia 1,100, cars 720, and the normal groceries.
Got it. I'll quit trying to recruit you for that window.
Still good for Wednesday soccer after your Thursday night brain-drain routine?
That tracks. Utilities are the swingy one in Wisconsin. Mine were stupid in Jan too.
Yeah. Thursday is just practice set 6 and Erin review notes. October feels far until those problems start.
Appreciate it. I still owe Workday the Dec 29-Jan 2 block, then my rolling-year tally matches the 10 Feb days.
Exactly. Summer gas is like 60, then winter laughs and writes 280.
That license better be worth the lost evenings. You said HR bands move a real amount after it?
The range I keep hearing is $15,000-$20,000 on base, plus more doors if I ever get tired of municipal work.
You still doing that title conversation tomorrow? Or did soccer bruises earn you a delay?
Tomorrow. Priya sent me one last note: don't bury the PE prep and municipal wins under 'team effort' language.
Smart. Whoever tells you to stop underselling should get a cut.
David has been saying the same thing since my first year here, just with fewer exclamation points.
Did you actually do the 3pm video today or did you hide in spreadsheets like a Vargas maniac
Did it. We talked about the two-year binder and why the November council packet still makes my stomach drop.
Good. Also Camila told me she kept her Tuesday thing too, so both of you get gold stars and zero extra committees.
Mom sent me Rosa's cousin spreadsheet again 😂 are you actually pricing GYE flights or just making a sacred tab in Excel
Mom asked if you drank the manzanilla she sent or if you are still being Engineer Spreadsheet about it 😂
Actual pricing. Current line is $4,500 and the ugly number is $9,000, so I am being boring and automatic about it.
Tell the charting gods I accepted the gold star. No committees added.
Just got out. Twelve-hour day, zero glamor, one surgeon who needs a mute button.
I drank it. Also took the tiny white tablet from the upstairs cabinet before soccer, so everybody can relax.
Madison owes you hazard pay and a medal.
Look at you, both worlds. Just shower before bed if you played outside, your eyes looked angry on FaceTime.
Boring is good. Lucia has like 3 years before double digits, hermano. Put the auto-transfer on and stop negotiating with yourself.
Pay me in sleep. The twins both popped out of bed at 5:30 yelling dinosaur facts.
Done for the 15th. Also Sunday call may be loud if all the cousins pile into Rosa's living room again.
Already did. And yes, I kept the Wauwatosa acupuncture card from 2022, before you ask.
Lucia only did one dinosaur monologue today, so I concede defeat.
My mom can keep Lucia until 10. Do you still want to go down by 13th, or are you too wiped from today?
Let's go. I already used the knife for half an hour at lunch, so I'm less wound up than I was after the bid review.
My dad asked if you still have the old Giannis cup or if Lucia turned it into a marker holder.
Still intact. Packers mug is the marker casualty.
Okay, amor. Then no giant batch before we leave. Last time the whole fridge smelled like lime and onion.
Claro. He also wants to know if he should bring the plantain chips or if you are doing your 'game food spreadsheet' again 🙄
Fair. I'll just pack the cilantro before it wilts and we can get the real plate tonight.
Plantain chips, yes. Spreadsheet only if the fourth quarter gets ugly.
My mom confirmed for Lucia tonight. Milwaukee or stay in the Falls?
Falls. I can grill the chicken and open the crisp Riesling from Sendik's after bedtime.
Perfect. One glass with dinner, maybe one while we clean up. No sleepy movie at 8:40, por favor.
Deal. I'll grab limes and the little salad Lucia likes.
Are you still bailing after one beer tonight? Marcus says you're doing your mysterious cultured-dad thing again 😂
Only half bailing. There is a 6:00 reception near Walker's Point with the O'Keeffe pieces in the back room.
Take the pocket notebook then. Last time you came back talking about shadow shapes on a water tower like it was a zoning hearing.
That's because the mural crew had the whole wall mapped in three values. I'm stealing that idea for the viaduct study.
If we do Bucks after soccer next week, are you still disappearing for that orange-haze detective movie thing first?
You still doing the Saturday morning woods thing once the mud chills out?
Only if the late show works. I want the big screen for the city shots.
Probably late June. If I leave before 7, I can hit Scuppernong and be home before Camila needs the car.
Nerd. Send me the book rec you mentioned too, the one with the haunted spaceship voice.
That's the one past Delafield, right? You and your 30-minute escapes 😂
I’ll send the title after dinner. It reads fast, but don’t start it at midnight.
Yep. For March I'm staying boring: Menomonee loops and stretching like an old man.
Mijo, la cita de Lucia para los ojos, Camila dijo que era martes. Tienes que llevar la tarjeta nueva?
Yes, I have the card. Same one we used for her January appointment. The account got the March deposit already.
Bueno. Y pregunta cuanto falta antes de que ya no cobren tanto, porque enero fue caro.
We are still before the $1,500 family mark, so I am expecting one more annoying bill before it eases up.
You still using that Holloway office by Bluemound? I need someone who can handle my rental mess this year.
Yeah, Sandra's in Brookfield. She's direct but good. She already asked me for our 2025 pile.
Good enough. Does she care about municipal receipts or just the bank forms?
She asked for the village confirmations too, especially the two big ones from the house folder.
Still want me to ask my Brookfield guy about permits? He said bring a sketch, not Pinterest pictures.
Sketch is generous. I have the old tile quote, the north-wall measurements, and Camila's 'not this year' face.
That face saves marriages and checking accounts.
Exactly. Last month's $1,800 was enough house spending for a while.
Can you swing by Appleton after the library? Lucia asked for the pink cookie again 🙄
Yep. If the glass case has guava, I'm getting one for you too.
Deal. Also I found the flower lady's card in the junk drawer. She wrote May 2 in the corner.
Good. We should bring the wagon that morning if Lucia is picking colors.
You going back to Denver this summer or only the Christmas-in-the-mountains routine?
Probably only December if Andres is around. Last summer was fun but not trying to repeat Mateo's dessert table choices.
Lmao the legendary half-serving?
Quarter, thank you. I was still useful enough to find the rideshare.
Mijo, Lucia left the blue fish cup on the porch. Is it for Sparkle?
No, that's for rinsing the sidewalk chalk. Sparkle's tiny spoon is by the tank.
Pancho barked when Erin came for the folding tables. I gave him one treat only.
Perfect. Camila marked the July box in the garage if Erin needs the banner too.
You still using that 26-check setup in your spreadsheet? Mine is twice a month and way easier.
Yep, 26. I just smooth it out or the months with an extra Friday look fake.
And you said the company adds half of what you put in, up to 5? That's solid.
Pretty much. I keep my side at 10. The old balance was just under 190k last statement.
Mom just asked if she needs to bring her little yellow card to West Allis cardiology. I swear she treats it like a passport 😂
Tell her yes, and I will bring mine Sunday so we can compare the messy handwriting.
Yours better be boring. You were the child who alphabetized baseball cards.
Boring enough that Camila only had one note after reading that Your Local Epidemiologist piece.
Did you two actually get dinner or did you waste Rafael's Lucia night comparing backsplash grout samples?
Dinner in Bay View. Camila made it through one margarita before talking about a kid's /r/ sound plan.
Of course she did. Tell CDMX at 12 that Wisconsin turned her into the person correcting toddlers and grown men.
She heard me laugh and said your twins would be easier than my board meeting notes.
I grabbed steel-cut oats and cod. Please don't bring home brats just because Sprecher's has them on special.
Deal. Patel said the swap only counts if I don't undo it every Wednesday after soccer.
Exacto. Also your Aurora summary says their form still has 6'0 from 2021. At least one thing is stable.
Rude but fair. I'll make the cod with the salsa verde, not butter.
Mijo, before you call, tell Camila the gray pants are finished. I left extra thread in the little bag.
Perfect. I'll swing by West Allis after we talk and grab them from the condo desk if you leave them there.
No desk. Come upstairs, I made coffee. I am not old enough to hand clothes to strangers.
Deal. Calling at five like usual, then I'll come over.
Camila told me you tried to sneak a Tuesday thing onto the calendar. Sir.
Not sneaking. Jamal asked if I could cover the MICAH canvass table twice in April.
Last fall you had Habitat, pantry, library, plus the extra school thing and looked like a haunted accountant.
I know. I told him I can do one Saturday after the Habitat budget vote, not another repeating slot.
Mami says you missed cafecito because you were on a Saturday Zoom with college babies. Again 😂
Two of them. That's my yearly cap, remember? Daniela had mock interview prep and Mateo wanted help choosing between field inspection and design.
Yearly cap my foot. You also sent me that spreadsheet with 'future firm values' at 1:12 AM.
It was just notes: who gets hired first, pro bono hours, and which drainage projects actually make bus stops usable.
Mom says your Tuesday fish smelled better than mine and now I am personally attacked.
Tell her I had supervision from the six-year-old salt inspector.
Sure, chef. Also did you send Mom's condo insurance thing or is that still in your paper mountain?
Sent this morning. Camila had Lucia's folder duty so I used the quiet 10 minutes.
You still bailing right after soccer tonight or Sprecher's for one?
One quick one max. I have to be at the library by 7:45 to help set up the fabric/mending tables.
Of course you are the guy with a cleat bag and a sewing kit in the same trunk.
The kit is Camila's old one. I am mostly carrying extension cords and folding signs.
M texted me the screenshot of your Saturday signup. She is already sharpening the chancla.
It was one volunteer slot, not a blood oath.
Her exact words: tell him Madison has two 4-year-olds and still knows what 'no' means.
Brutal. Effective, but brutal.
Still good for one beer after the match next Wed, or is Lilly Creek eating the day?
Lilly Creek 8:30, office after, then soccer. I may skip the second round.
Fair. You sounded cooked last week.
Deadline week is tracking 54-ish if Friday's review holds. I'm leaving the PE book closed after 10:30 tonight.
You coming by after the match or heading straight home?
Sprecher's for a bit. If they have the pilsner, I'll do that with the pretzel and then call it.
Good. I need someone sane at the table while Diego litigates offside for 40 minutes.
I can supervise exactly one pretzel and one lecture.
Lucia is asleep. You can have the couch, but no bass rumble shaking the vents like last time.
Subtitles and low volume. I just want the worm scene before bed.
Fine, mi amor. Also your Libby hold came in, the one with the translator notes and impossible calendar math.
Perfect. Movie first, then a chapter if I don’t fall asleep.
Captain wants you at forward Wednesday. Outdoor field though. You bringing the pharmacy stash or are we watching you blink through the first half? ⚽
I picked up the 90-day bottle this month, so I’m covered. Also putting the eucalipto tin in my bag because Gloria will somehow know if I don’t.
Your mom has satellite surveillance, hermano.
She also told me manzanilla fixes half of Milwaukee County, so yes, surveillance with tea.
